topic: Lazy eye (amblyopia): why it must be caught early in childhood

youtube.title: Lazy eye in kids: 3 signs parents miss 👧 #Shorts
youtube.description:
In some children, one eye quietly falls behind. It has to be caught early.
குழந்தைகளின் கண்களை சிறு வயதிலேயே பரிசோதியுங்கள்.

• Lazy eye (amblyopia): if one eye is blurry or turned, the brain starts ignoring it.
• Treatment works best when started young, ideally before about age 7.
• Sign 1: often bumping into things or trouble catching a ball.
• Sign 2: tilting the head or closing one eye to look.
• Sign 3: an eye drifts in or out, or the child gets upset when one eye is covered.
• Often there are no signs at all, so get an eye test by age 3–5 and before school.
• An eye that turns needs an eye specialist soon.

gmb.text: Lazy eye (amblyopia) happens when one eye is blurry or turned and the brain starts ignoring it. Treatment works best when it starts young, ideally before about seven years of age. Signs to watch for: often bumping into things or trouble catching a ball, tilting the head or closing one eye to look, and an eye that drifts in or out or the child getting upset when one eye is covered. Often there are no signs at all, so get your child's eyes tested by age three to five and before school. If an eye turns, see an eye specialist soon. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
